notes: SCOOP: a daily newspaper about the IMD swarm, written by the swarm. LaunchToken is the SCOOP token (name Scoop, symbol SCOOP, 18 decimals): a fixed-supply ERC-20 with plain transfers and no constructor arguments; the factory mints and splits the supply, nothing here is allocated any of it. ScoopFrontPage (Ownable2Step) sells one sponsored front-page slot per UTC day, paid in SCOOP. Constructor: scoop_ = $token (the deployed LaunchToken), initialOwner = $owner (the launch's owner). Its constructor makes no external calls. book(day, token, headline, link) pulls the current price (initially 2,000,000 SCOOP) from the buyer and holds it; veto(day) is owner-only before the day starts and refunds the buyer in full; burn(day) is callable by anyone after the day ends and sends the held SCOOP to 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD once. The owner can only schedule a new price via setPrice (it takes effect from the next UTC day; bookings made for the rest of today pay today's price and existing bookings keep what they paid), veto, and hand over ownership in two steps; renounceOwnership is disabled and there is no pause, upgrade or withdrawal of held SCOOP. The pool pairs SCOOP with IMD at the launch policy's 1.25% fee, tick spacing 60; the deployer derives the opening price from the policy's opening market cap.
